review: Many people probably know the meme scene about “Pizza with nothing”. Now we have an Identity that is the equivalent of that. Haute Couture::Boutique du Rouge Ishmael is an Identity that lacks identity. Haute Couture::Boutique du Rouge Ishmael is a Bleed identity that does nothing better than past identities, and her “tanking” is quite special. On a brighter note, she doesn’t need to interact with the Charge mechanic, due to her having the Multicrack special of consuming HP to achieve conditionals. So to summarize, she is a Charge identity with Bleed sprinkled into it (we already have IDs that do well with this combination and it's called HoS Ring IDs), and can be categorized as “tank” (for about 2 turns in Changing Room state, does nothing in said turns) who also consumes her own HP as fast as possible.
